🎥🎬: Resident Evil (2026)

Bryan, a medical courier, is assigned an urgent delivery to a hospital in the remote mountains, expecting nothing more than another routine job. But when a horrifying accident leaves him stranded, he finds himself caught in the middle of a nightmare as infected people and grotesque creatures begin hunting him. With no safe place to turn, Bryan must fight his way through the chaos to survive the night.

As he pushes toward Raccoon City, Bryan encounters terrifying mutations linked to a catastrophic biological experiment involving the Umbrella Corporation. What begins as a simple delivery becomes a desperate race through a city collapsing under a deadly outbreak, where every encounter brings a new horror and every bullet could be his last.

With time running out and the infection spreading, Bryan must reach his destination and uncover the truth behind the disaster before he becomes another victim of the nightmare. In a world overrun by mutated horrors, survival is the only mission that matters.

source_details.title: Resident Evil
source_details.synopsis: Resident Evil is a 2026 horror film directed by Zach Cregger and written by Cregger and Shay Hatten. It is the eighth live-action Resident Evil film, based on the Resident Evil video game franchise by Capcom. Austin Abrams stars as Bryan Hodukavich, a medical courier who encounters a zombie outbreak on his way to Raccoon City. Zach Cherry, Kali Reis, and Paul Walter Hauser feature in supporting roles. Constantin Film began planning a reboot of the Resident Evil film series in early 2022, following the failure of the previous reboot, Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City (2021). Cregger was hired in January 2025, and Sony Interactive Entertainment's PlayStation Productions joined the product
